Package com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository

Class FirebaseConnector

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlotteryapp.repository.FirebaseConnector
public class FirebaseConnector extends Object
Provides a single point of access to the Firebase Firestore instance and exposes named collection references used throughout the app.
